domain_note: Authenticated bytes are the ASCII domain, one NUL byte, then the canonical payload with signature or mac removed.
authenticator_note: Cases marked authenticator=valid must pass cryptographic verification so the semantic rule under test is actually reached. Cases marked invalid fail verification itself.
warning: Seeds below are published test values and must never sign anything real.
chain_row_note: The chain row is the evidence record. Its signature covers the canonical bytes in canonical_json directly, with no domain prefix, and a verifier reads those bytes rather than re-canonicalising the row object.
wire_note: canonical_hex is the envelope preimage: the canonical payload with signature removed. The wire carries the complete artifact.
derivation_note: key_id and anchor_epoch_id are derived per runtime-evidence-anchor/v1.

cases.name: valid
cases.note: Canonical bytes reproduce; envelope and chain-row signatures both verify.

cases.name: replayed_envelope
cases.note: Byte-identical replay: idempotent accept, no duplicate state, existing receipt unchanged.

cases.name: same_seq_different_digest
cases.note: Valid signature; same local_seq with a different chain_row_digest is recorded as a conflict, never applied.

cases.name: reordered_batch
cases.note: Arrives before local_seq 12; ordering is by local_seq, not arrival.

cases.name: rollback_unseen_digest
cases.note: Valid signature; local_seq below the receipted frontier carrying a digest never seen for that sequence.

cases.name: wrong_device
cases.note: Correctly signed, but device_id is not registered. Security-audited, no gap recorded against a device the authority does not know.

cases.name: foreign_chain_row
cases.note: Envelope and row signatures both verify, but the row belongs to another device than the envelope names.

cases.name: chain_row_signature_invalid
cases.note: Envelope signature valid; the row is signed by a key not registered to this device.

cases.name: chain_row_digest_mismatch
cases.note: Valid signature; digest does not match the digest recomputed over canonical_json.

cases.name: wrong_epoch_never_held
cases.note: Names an epoch this device never held; the epoch obligation stays pending.

cases.name: superseded_epoch
cases.note: Evidence signed under an epoch active at the time stays valid and is attributable to the epoch that authorised it.

cases.name: unknown_field
cases.note: Signed including the undefined field, so the rejection is about the field and not about the signature.

cases.name: unrecognised_version
cases.note: Correctly signed at v=2; receivers reject unrecognised versions rather than ignoring unknown fields.
